name: Wholeness of Body
entries: You gain the ability to heal yourself. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can roll your Martial Arts die. You regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the number rolled plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} regained).
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
